prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Play while your pet gets ready!"]
2: ["Practice Desktop Companion Controls", "Try right-clicking to open settings, dragging your pet, and toggling companion visibility.", "Got It, Launch Pet!"]
3: ["Save & Protect Your Companion Account", "Signing in links your pet securely to your account so you never lose your companion when switching devices or logging in later."]
4: ["Official Companion Adoption", "Your companion is officially registered to your account.", "Account Protected"]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Workspace"]
6: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Click below to summon your pet directly onto your desktop screen.", "Launch Pet onto Desktop Now"]
7: ["Select Your Companion's Journey", "Choose how you want your desktop companion to assist and play on your screen."]
8: ["Choose Desktop Companion Home Spot", "Select where your companion should hang out on your screen.", "Confirm Location"]
9: ["Secure Your Pet Across Devices", "Log into your account to keep your companion safe and synced across your desktop machines.", "Sync & Account Backup Enabled"]
